agentTalk: Build an interactive page from this website plan.
Sure. I’ll outline the page structure, implement a responsive layout and interactions, then return the files and validation notes.
Page files and validation notes
Build the product website
Ask Codex to implement the agreed website content and return the page files and validation notes.
Review this product introduction. How could it be clearer?
Start with what people want to achieve. Explain what the assistant can complete, then use concrete conversations to show how agents collaborate.
Product narrative and copy suggestions
Clarify the product story
Ask Claude to discuss the structure of the product introduction and put together clear copy suggestions.
What questions about personal AI assistants are worth exploring?
We could explore how tasks continue over time, how people and assistants share the work, and how multiple agents collaborate, with questions to investigate.
Exploration questions and perspectives
Explore product perspectives
Ask Grok bot to discuss AI assistant use cases from different perspectives and return a list of questions.
How should we break this page brief into verifiable engineering tasks?
Split it into layout, interactions, mobile checks and file delivery, with clear completion criteria for each step.
Engineering plan and delivery checklist
Outline the engineering plan
Ask Devin to break the website brief into engineering steps and list the deliverables and checks for each.
